expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will explore richer message metadata and payload support, including request IDs for correlating requests and responses, timestamps for recording message creation time, and optional payloads for carrying message-specific data, while preserving the existing Ping behavior where practical.

Shipped v2 Hello with an explicit v2 envelope for encoding and decoding `Msg::Hello(String)`.
